verdict.rationale: LiteLLM Proxy issues virtual keys that can restrict which models a key may access. Each key can also carry its own spending budget, and MCP tool access can be controlled by key or team, which together give a scoped, least-privilege credential an agent can use. The community remark about issues creating tokens for other users is vague and not a concrete counter-example, so it lowers confidence rather than creating a dispute. Missing for 10: documented route/endpoint-level permission scoping, key expiry/rotation details, agent-specific identity guidance, and independent hands-on corroboration of key scoping.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent

citations.quote: Track Spend, and control model access via virtual keys for the proxy
control MCP access by Key, Team
Create virtual keys without team_id for individual spending limits
